title: Extended Diploma Level 5 In Information Technology
description: The purpose of this extended Diploma Level 5 in Information Technology is to develop students professionally and individually who can satisfy the demands of the IT sector and work in a constantly changing world.
longDescription: The purpose of this extended Diploma Level 5 in Information Technology is to professionally and personally develop students who are adept at meeting the demands of the tech sector and adapting to an ever-evolving digital landscape. This course enhances your ability to understand IT challenges, analyze technical problems, and devise effective solutions. It introduces fundamental concepts crucial to IT operations, ensuring that whether you pursue further education or enter the workforce, you will be distinguished by a robust understanding of essential IT skills. The extended Diploma Level 5 in Information Technology lays the foundation for advanced IT studies and career opportunities. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: 17 source-listed curriculum sections and 0 lesson or resource entries are included below.
entry: For entry into extended Diploma Level 5 in Information Technology, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to complete a Master degree programme from one of our Partner University. The top-up programme can be studied online or on campus. The top-up comprises the final 60 credits which consist of either a dissertation or a dissertation and one module. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) University Progression Click here to see University routes and fee information for progression.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
